## Useful things to include

A short note is enough. If helpful, tell me:

- the decision, problem, or opportunity you are working on;
- who needs to use the result;
- what data or systems already exist;
- whether there is a deadline or external requirement;
- what you have tried already; and
- what a successful outcome would look like.

I can help determine the appropriate scope from there.

## Common starting points

::: {.engagement-grid}
::: {.engagement-card}
### “We have data, but we are not getting useful answers from it.”
Start with analysis, measurement, research design, or analytics strategy.
:::
::: {.engagement-card}
### “Our reporting process is too manual.”
Start with workflow assessment, automation, reproducible reporting, or data-pipeline design.
:::
::: {.engagement-card}
### “People need to explore the data themselves.”
Start with dashboard, decision-support, or R/Shiny application design.
:::
::: {.engagement-card}
### “We know our analytics systems need to change.”
Start with stakeholder needs assessment, architecture evaluation, and modernization planning.
